target: Sentry (Software Engineer Intern — error monitoring / observability; Python + JS/TS)
phase: 4/4 - eval + bench + report (all Must-have v1 complete, measured)
stack: Python 3.12 + FastAPI + uvicorn + pydantic v2 + SQLite (WAL); TypeScript SDK on Node >=20 (tsc + vitest); pytest + coverage; Docker + docker-compose
store_choice: SQLite (documented) — local, zero external services, all SQL isolated in sentinel/store.py
tests: 48 pytest (95% coverage on sentinel/) + 16 vitest = 64 passing

measurement_methodology.grouping: pairwise precision/recall over all C(81,2)=3240 event pairs of a synthetic/crafted labeled dataset (eval/dataset.py, seed=1337; 81 events, 10 true groups); homogeneity/completeness are entropy-based (sklearn formulas, implemented in eval/grouping_eval.py); 1 deliberate false split (retry-wrapper frame) kept so recall is honest
measurement_methodology.dedupe: seeded mixed stream (bench/util.py, seed=2024; 12 root causes) ingested via store_event; raw events / resulting issues
measurement_methodology.throughput: 5000 events; HTTP path = POST /api/store via FastAPI TestClient (ASGI, no socket) incl. JSON parse + pydantic + fingerprint + dedupe + alert eval; raw path = direct store_event over pre-built envelopes; on-disk SQLite WAL
measurement_methodology.latency: in-process FastAPI TestClient (ASGI), excludes network socket; 2000 requests each, 100 warmup excluded; per-request perf_counter
measurement_methodology.sdk_overhead: 20000 iterations, error thrown 3 levels deep (9 frames/event), Node v22.23.1, in-memory transport (no network), performance.now() per call
measurement_methodology.e2e_demo: scripts/run_demo.sh: uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:8000 + compiled SDK demo over a REAL socket -> 30 events -> 4 grouped issues, uncaught RangeError auto-captured, new_issue+threshold alerts fired

unmeasured.socket_latency: ___ (latency/throughput measured in-process via TestClient, not over a real HTTP/TCP socket; socket path proven functional by the demo but not timed)
unmeasured.docker_compose_up: compose stack (api + webhook + demo) provided and valid; base-image registry pulls intermittently timed out (DeadlineExceeded) in the build sandbox, so the socket demo is the verified end-to-end path

notes: All Must-have v1 delivered: TypeScript SDK (uncaught handler + captureException + V8 stack parse -> normalized frames with in-app rules + context) -> Python FastAPI /api/store (pydantic boundary validation) -> deterministic SHA-1 stack-frame fingerprint grouping (line/col excluded; message normalization strips addr/hex/uuid/int+unit/quoted/email; in-app preferred; configurable rules) -> SQLite issue store with dedupe by (project,fingerprint) (first/last_seen, count, culprit, sample; idempotent re-delivery) -> query API (/issues filter+sort, /issues/{id}, resolve/ignore/unresolve) + alerts (new-issue + threshold-in-window -> log/webhook) + minimal HTML dashboard. Grouping precision 1.000 / recall 0.947 on a crafted labeled set (0 false merges, 1 honest false split). KEY HONESTY: latency/throughput are in-process TestClient (not socket); grouping dataset is synthetic/crafted; store is SQLite not Postgres (bullet template corrected). Out-of-scope (not built): source-map symbolication, per-project rate limiting/quotas, spike-detection alerts, production UI framework, real Sentry Relay/ClickHouse.
